title: Satin Lounge Bodysuit — Everyday Coverage | Champagne | Solid | Lounge & Sleepwear | 76% Polyamide, 24% Spandex | Adjustable straps
description:
This bodysuit is built around coverage. The bottom is fully lined in a double layer, so it is genuinely opaque, and the back coverage is full enough that it can be worn under a shirt or a sweater without anything showing.

The satin is matte rather than shiny. Shiny satin reads as costume; matte reads as something you could leave the house in. It has a slight sheen in direct light but stays quiet under indoor lighting.

It works three ways: on its own at home, under a blazer for an evening out, or as a sleepwear piece. The straps adjust, the gusset is cotton-spandex with snaps, and the leg opening sits high enough to stay smooth under trousers or a skirt.

WHAT MAKES IT WORK
• Fully lined — genuinely opaque, not a lined-for-show version
• Full back coverage, so it works under a shirt or sweater
• Matte satin that reads as loungewear rather than costume
• Adjustable straps and a cotton snap gusset
• High-cut leg that stays smooth under trousers

DETAILS
• Material: 76% Polyamide, 24% Spandex; matte satin outer, cotton gusset
• Color: Champagne
• Closure: Adjustable straps; snap gusset
• Pattern: Solid
• Origin: Made in China
• Care: Machine wash cold on a delicate cycle. Hang to dry.

FIT & SIZING
True to size with a close fit. Size up if you want a looser feel. The fabric stretches about 1.5 inches across the bust.
Model is 5'9" (175 cm) with a 35" bust and 27" waist, wearing size S.

Sizing tips:
• Measure your underbust — the band directly under the bust, snug but not tight. This matters more than the bust measurement for anything with a bodysuit fit.
• Measure your hip at the widest point, roughly 8 inches below the waist. This is the number most people underestimate.
• If you are between sizes, size up for sleepwear and lounge pieces, and size down for fitted bodysuits where you want a close fit.
• Fabric stretch varies by style. Each product page lists how much give the fabric has — styles listed as "about 2 inches of stretch" will size down more easily.
• Between a standard size and an extended size? Take the standard size. The jump to extended sizing changes torso length and gusset volume, not just the measurements.

QUESTIONS WE GET A LOT
Q: Is this bodysuit actually opaque?
A: Yes. The bottom is fully lined in a double layer rather than partially lined, so it is opaque when worn without additional underwear.

Q: Can I wear it under regular clothes?
A: That is what the full back coverage and matte satin are for. It sits smooth under a shirt, sweater, or blazer without showing through.

Q: How is the satin different from costume satin?
A: It is matte rather than high-shine. Shiny satin photographs as costume; matte satin reads as something you would wear out. It has a slight sheen in direct light.

Q: Does it work as sleepwear?
A: Yes. The fabric is soft and the gusset is cotton-spandex, so it is comfortable for sleeping as well as for an evening out.
